claims: An official OpenTelemetry OTLP HTTP exporter sends an ordinary root span and a GenAI child span into the real Chorus receiver
Chorus displays the persisted service, model, trace duration, and currency-aware cost from canonical OTLP
Root-row promotion selects the GenAI child within that root and persists an evaluation case linked to the real trace, root, and child span IDs
demoCommands: Official OpenTelemetry SDK plus OTLPSpanExporter to http://127.0.0.1:8113/v1/traces, then browser Promote on the root row
isolation: Dedicated /tmp corpus, synthetic evidence-agent data, localhost only, no production services or message delivery
limitations: Local OTLP HTTP path only; no production deployment or external collector
